about_short_description.short_description: AccessOwl automates the provisioning and permissioning of SaaS accounts for employees.

product.name: Shadow IT Scan
product.description: A tool that scans an organization's workspace to identify unauthorized or unmanaged SaaS applications and their OAuth permissions.

product.name: AccessOwl SaaS Access Management Platform
product.description: A platform that centralizes management of employee access to SaaS applications, including access requests, approvals, reviews, and onboarding/offboarding workflows.

product.name: Automated Provisioning Add-On
product.description: An add-on service that automates user account provisioning and deprovisioning across more than 200 SaaS applications.

product.name: Shadow IT Request & Approval Workflow
product.description: A workflow system that manages employee requests for SaaS app access, including approval processes to control shadow IT usage.

product.name: Access Review and Compliance Reporting
product.description: Tools for conducting regular access reviews and generating reports to support security compliance and audit requirements.
